metadata.analysis: Anderson finished Week 5 prep with a DNP-LP-FP practice log, and that was enough for the fourth-year pass rusher to avoid an injury designation for Sunday's AFC South showdown. Anderson has 23 tackles (13 solo), including 4.5 sacks, one pass defense, one forced fumble and a fumble recovery through the first four games of the regular season.
metadata.description: Anderson (ankle) does not have an injury tag against the Titans on Sunday.
metadata.title: Will Anderson - Good to go against Tennessee

metadata.analysis: Anderson will be good to go in his usual role on the Texans defensive line.
metadata.description: Will Anderson Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Titans.
metadata.title: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) off injury report Sunday

metadata.analysis: Anderson was able to practice in a limited capacity on Thursday after being sidelined due to an ankle issue on Wednesday. He should play in Week 5, barring any setbacks with his recovery.
metadata.description: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
metadata.title: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) upgraded to limited Thursday
